Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to

SPECIFICATION FOR 
WOODEN JOINTER FOR TWO-MEN CROSS CUT SAWS 



I. Scope — Specifies the material, dimensions and other requirements for wooden jointers used 
for the maintenance of two-men cro^s cut saws according to 15:12127-1987 "Specification for 
two-men cross cut saws*. 

2, Material — Wooden jointers shall be made of good quality seasoned carpentry wood. 

X\ The wooden blanks shall be free from centre heart ( pith ), decay ( rot ), checks, shakes, splits, 
borer holes, warp, etc. 

3, Shape and Dimensions

FIG. 1 WOODEN JOINTER FOR TWO-MEN CROSS CUT SAWS 

3M Tolerances for the dimensions shall be very coarse class specified in IS : 2102 ( Part 1) - 1M0 
General tolerances for dimensions and form and position : Part 1 General tolerances for linear and 
angular dimensions ( second revision )\ 

3.1 The flat file shown in Fig. 1 ( see Explanatory Note for the diqi^^ensions of the flat file ) shall be 
used one and shall be fitted by the user before performing the jointing operation with the wooden 
jointer. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — Wooden jpinters shall be finished smooth. They shall be free from 
burrs, sharp edges, cracks and other defects. 

4J It is recommended that, immediately after manufacture, wooden jointers shall be dipped In raw 
linseed oil at about 90°C for one hour. 

5, Designation — The wooden jointer shall be designated by its name and the number of this 
Indian Standard as: 

Wooden jointer IS : 12413 

6, Marking — Each wooden jointer shall be clearly and legibly stamped with the manufacturer's 
name or trade-mark, if any, and the batch or code number. 

6.1 Standard Mariiing — Details available wi^h the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

7. Packing — Shall be as agreed to between! the manufacturer and the purchaser.

8, Sampling — Unless Otherwise agreed to between the supplier and the purchaser, the sampling 
plan and criteria for conformity shall be as given In Appendix A, 



A P P E N D I X A 

( Clause 8 ) 
SCALE OF SAMPLING AND CRiTERiA FOR CONFORMITY 

A-L Scale of Sampiing 

A-M Lot — In any consignment, all the wooden jointers of the same nominal size manufactured 
under similar conditions of manufacture shall be grouped together to constitute a lot. 

A-il.2 For ascertaining the conformity of the lot to the requirements of this specification, tests shall 
be carried out on the wooden jointer selected from each lot separately. The number of wooden 
jointers to be selected at random from a lot shall be in accordance with col 1 and 2 of Table 1. To 
ensure the raudomness of selection, the procedure laid down in IS : 4905-1968 'Methods for random 
sampling' may be followed. 

TABLE 1 SAMPLING SIZE AND PERMISSIBLE NUMBER OF DEFECTIVES 

Lot Size Sample Size Permissible Number of 

Defectives 

(1) (2) (3) 

Up to 50 5 

51 to 150 8 

151 to 300 13 1 

301 to 500 *' 20 2 

501 and above 32 3 

A-2. Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity 

A-2J The wooden jointers selected according to A-1.2 shall be examined for material ( see 2 ), 
dimensions ( see 3 ) and general requirements ( see 41. Any wooden jointer failing to meet the 
requirements for any one or more of the characteristics shall be declared defective. 

A-2JJ The lot shall be considered conforming to the requirements of the characteristics men- 
tioned in A-2. 1, if the number of wooden jointers found defective is less than or equal to the corres- 
ponding number given in col 3 of Table 1. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Wooden jointers are used to take off the points at right angle to the surface of the saw blade 
so that the teeth which are set to the left are brought to the same height as those which are set to 
the right side. 

The flat file shown in Fig. i shall be of used one and shall be fitted by the user before using the 
wooden jointer. This flat file shall be of 200 mm length, 21 mm width and shall have 22 cuts/centi- 
metre. This used file may be supplied by the manufacturer at the option of the pu.rchaser^
